title: Support of a current from a mass–measure identity
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and μ a measure on ℝ^P with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P (M_W(T) = T.massOn W). Then spt T = U ∩ spt μ, where spt T = T.support (Simon 6.2.11) and spt μ = μ.support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) → T.support = U ∩ μ.support
